tw: Kron works overtime till nine, sewing clover on Rover's coat in time.
twc: Kron 加班到九点，赶着给小狗罗孚的外套缝三叶草。

tw: The perk of the new job: a perky turkey serves Kron burgers at work.
twc: 新工作的福利：一只精神的火鸡在公司给 Kron 端汉堡。

tw: Kron's prospects? The boss expects him to collect cross insects from the moss.
twc: Kron 的前途？老板要他去苔藓里收集生气的虫子。

tw: Kron shares his pears with three bears on the stairs, and they stare.
twc: Kron 在楼梯上把梨分给三只熊，熊们直勾勾盯着他。

tw: On night shift work, Kron lifts gifts so swift the other workers' shirts flip up.
twc: 上夜班，Kron 搬礼物快得把工友的衬衫都掀起来了。

tw: Kron shows his skills: skiing downhill, he holds a tray of milk with no spills.
twc: Kron 秀技能：滑雪下山，手托一盘牛奶一滴没洒。

tw: Kron the supervisor wears a super visor to supervise the soup supply.
twc: 主管 Kron 戴着超大遮阳帽，盯着汤罐生产线。

tw: Kron's takeover: he takes over the bakery and makes cakes over and over.
twc: Kron 收购了面包店，一遍又一遍地做蛋糕。

tw: Kron enjoys unemployment: under the sun, he employs ten toys to bring him lemonade.
twc: Kron 享受失业：在太阳下雇十个玩具给他送柠檬水。

tw: On payday, Kron's wages arrive in a cage: eight grapes and a grey snail.
twc: 发薪日，Kron 的工资装在笼子里：八颗葡萄和一只灰蜗牛。

tw: Kron's workforce of forty worms works for corn on the farm floor.
twc: Kron 手下四十条蚯蚓，在农场地上为玉米打工。

tw: In casual shorts, Kron casually catches a cat that's catching cashews.
twc: Kron 穿着休闲短裤，随手接住一只正在接腰果的猫。

tw: Economical Kron and Tom feed ten friends one egg in comical tiny slices.
twc: Kron 和猫汤姆很省：一个鸡蛋切成小片喂十个朋友。

tw: Exhausting work: Kron hauls a horse across the lawn, and the next horse waits.
twc: 累死了：Kron 把一匹马拖过草坪，下一匹还在等。

tw: Kron's hospitality: hot pickle pie and tea for his pal Hal in the hospital.
twc: Kron 热情款待：给住院的朋友哈尔送热腌黄瓜派和茶。

tw: Kron taps one monotonous note on a hot pot, on and on, till dawn.
twc: Kron 在热锅上敲同一个音，敲啊敲，敲到天亮。

tw: In retail, Kron sells a free tail to a pale whale on sale.
twc: Kron 在零售店把一条免费的尾巴卖给一头苍白的鲸。
hint: 鲸鱼不缺尾巴，缺推销员。

tw: Made redundant, Kron has fun: he runs a bun stand under the sun.
twc: 被裁员后 Kron 很开心：在太阳下开了个小面包摊。

tw: Unskilled at drills, Kron drills one bun and fills the room with crumbs.
twc: Kron 不会用电钻，钻了个面包，满屋都是面包屑。

tw: Kron smiles to endorse horse sauce, and ten horses, of course, want more.
twc: Kron 微笑代言马牌酱，十匹马当然都想再来点。
